hints.content: A relative maximum point is a point that is higher than all other graph points around it. It's like the highest point on a "peak."

The graph has two relative maximum points in the given section. One at $(-3,-4)$, and one at $(5,6)$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A function is made up of line segments and curved lines. The function starts at negative seven, negative eight and it increases at a non linear rate to negative three, negative four. Then it decreases at a non linear to zero, negative six. A line segment connects zero, negative six to two, three. Then it increases at a non linear rate to five, six. Then is decreases at a non linear rate to eight, three.
